title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What do you think the timeline is for them to announce staff changes? Have you been told yet? Off record, not for use
All coming back except Steve ██████, he decided to retire. I’m sure they’ll announce it shortly
Steve’s my best friend in the game! Very good baseball man, he’ll be missed
Great man. Is Anne doing ok or is it just time for him? I mean, I’ll get in touch with him.
I think they are moving coaches around within. But all will be back in the Major Keagues
